title.narrative: Feeding Basket in the Republic of Niger 2025

description.narrative: Alleviating suffering and bringing joy to the most needy and affected families in the Republic of Niger through the distribution of 5,000 food baskets benefiting 30,000 beneficiaries.
Bringing joy to the most needy and affected families in the Republic of Niger, where 5,000 food baskets were distributed benefiting 30,000 beneficiaries.
Help heads of needy families bear the food expenses of their families and the most vulnerable relatives.
Disbursement for "Feeding Basket in the Republic of Niger 2025" in Niger, implemented by Al-Buraq Charitable Organization
